sources.title: Qwen 2.5 Complete Guide — Coder vs Base, VRAM Requirements & Best Sizes
sources.snippet: Qwen 2.5 remains one of the most downloaded model families on Ollama, and for good reason. Alibaba shipped a full lineup — general-purpose base models from 0.5B to 72B, dedicated Coder variants for programming, and vision-language models — all under permissive Apache 2.0 licenses (except the 72B, which uses the Qwen License).
